acceptance_predicates.description: Fallback builds use only catalog-pinned source, declared toolchain, declared recipe, and verified output/entrypoint.
Missing declared dependencies are built/acquired into a project-owned prefix or reused only after identity validation; no root/global package-manager mutation occurs.
Build execution clears credentials, constrains environment/network/resource/time, rejects arbitrary hooks, and retains only safe bounded diagnostics.
Tool plus dependency closure publishes atomically with receipt and transactional cleanup; failure preserves prior usable state.
Toolchain, platform, dependency, policy, output, resource, timeout, cancellation, and cleanup failures remain distinct and actionable.

definition_of_done: At least one supported tool for each declared build family passes reproducible project-local source-build qualification.
Hostile and failure fixtures plus independent exact-head/exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1776 catalog source and build recipes.

outputs.description: Bounded pinned source-builder and project dependency materializer.

gates.description: Pinned source/dependency project-prefix builds and reproducibility tests pass.
Hostile environment/script, resource, cleanup, and secret-boundary tests pass.
